entries.title: Trial of the Champion
body: The Crusaders' Coliseum, raised at the heart of the Argent Tournament grounds in the shadow of Icecrown. Here Tirion Fordring tests the champions of every people, mounted and on foot, against each other and against the Crusade's own best, to find those fit to stand against the Lich King.

entries.title: Eadric the Pure
body: A paladin, Grand Champion of the Argent Crusade, whom Tirion asked to coordinate the training of the tournament's champions and to bolster the defences of its grounds.

entries.title: Argent Confessor Paletress
body: A priestess of the Crusade who preaches to the champions in the Argent Pavilion, and hears their confessions behind her screen.

entries.title: The Black Knight
body: An agent of the Lich King sent to disrupt Tirion Fordring's tournament, a murderer of its champions whose crimes were exposed and who was struck down in the Ring of Champions. He did not stay dead. In the middle of the trials, he rode down out of the rafters.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg: Trial of the Champion (The Black Knight)
